quests.title: Short Delivery, Gadigal
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The Gadigal order has been two cartons light every week since grand final week and the invoice says otherwise every time. I am aware how that sounds. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Gadigal
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $31 owing to Gadigal and it is not going to walk in here itself. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: $31, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Gadigal Run
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. I do the Gadigal run at knock-off and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Town Hall
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Gadigal
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. I have got a chest freezer that hums in D in the back of the van and the Gadigal shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Gadigal
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Three of the Gadigal regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $29 down on those days. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$29, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Gadigal
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Everything Gadigal sells comes off a floor at Haymarket, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us

quests.title: Under 12s at Cherrybrook
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. I have got eleven kids for a twelve-a-side at Cherrybrook on the Sunday after payday and one of them has a note from his mother. I am aware how that sounds. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the estate behind the ground, ask around
the noticeboard where the sign-on sheet went up
any kid with boots will do at this point

quests.title: Registration, Cherrybrook
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. We found a twelfth, which means the Cherrybrook club now owes the association $59 it had budgeted on not owing. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: $59 before the cut-off
I will drive it in myself

quests.title: The Cherrybrook Canteen
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. The canteen at Cherrybrook does two hundred sausages on a Saturday and this week the freezer went off at first light. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: we are going to need the coffee
the thermometer, so the insurance believes us

quests.title: Grand Final Float, Cherrybrook
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Somebody walked off with the float from the Cherrybrook canteen at about first light during the last home game, and I have a fair idea which somebody. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the pair who were leaning on the roller door
$86, which is what was in the tin

quests.title: Sprinkler Line, Cherrybrook
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. The sprinkler line under the Cherrybrook outfield has been leaking since the Sunday after payday and the wet patch has started to move. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: walk the line from the tap to the boundary
where the grass has gone dark
I want to dig once, not five times

quests.title: The Association, Cherrybrook
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The bloke who allocates grounds for the whole association sits at Castle Hill, and Cherrybrook has been at the bottom of his list for two seasons. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: go and be reasonable at him
tell me if it is us or the paperwork

quests.title: The Creek Behind Clarendon
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Somebody has been tipping fill into the creek behind Clarendon since Thursdays and it is narrowing the channel a metre at a time. I am aware how that sounds. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the fill, with the water level in shot
the council reads photographs, not letters

quests.title: Willow Removal, Clarendon
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. They have agreed to a clean-up at Clarendon, which is wonderful, except the grant is $38 short and closes on Thursdays. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: $38, and I do not care whose pocket
the form needs the number today

quests.title: Sandbags, Clarendon
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. We had 61 sandbags in the Clarendon shed on Thursdays and this morning we have got the pallet they came on. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: the yards backing onto the reserve
anywhere they have obviously been used

quests.title: The Low Crossing, Clarendon
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. People keep driving the low crossing at Clarendon at half six with the water over the sign, and one of them is going to be the one. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: you will be standing out there a while
the ones who argue with the barrier

quests.title: Under the House, Clarendon
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. The water came through my place at Clarendon on Thursdays and the assessor wants photographs of things I have already thrown out. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: round the side, where the pile is
the high-water mark on the brick

quests.title: Upstream, Clarendon
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Whatever is happening to Clarendon starts upstream at East Richmond, and there are people up there who have been saying so for years. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: go up and find them
I want to hear it from someone who is not me
